name: Fix a pull request so it can land
description: Fix a build's pull request so the lander can land it: resolve a code conflict with main, fix red CI or failing build rules, on the PR's own branch. Push to that branch only; never push to main and never merge. The lander (deploy/lander) runs CI on the push and does the merge.
author: AmberX AXF

inputs.label: What failed
inputs.default: the failing checks on the pull request

data.brief:
Fix branch {{branch}} (build {{build}}) so its pull request can land. What failed: {{checks}}.
1. git fetch origin; work on {{branch}} only.
2. A conflict with main: git merge origin/main (never rebase, never force), resolve every conflict keeping both sides' intent. Bookkeeping files (_claude/THREADS.md, _claude/memory/STATUS.md, _claude/builds/, tracker.json, catalogs): keep both sides' lines, then regenerate generated files (tracker.mjs).
3. Red CI or failing build rules: reproduce the failing check, fix the code, rerun it until it passes.
4. Commit and push to the PR branch only: git push origin HEAD:{{branch}}. Never push to main. Never open, merge or close a pull request: the lander runs CI on your push and merges.
5. If it cannot be fixed, push nothing and say why.
Report what you changed (commit), what failed and what still needs a person.
